_comment: npm test is stricter than no_new_failures because the suite is green at the pinned base: every test must pass, rather than permitting failures already present at baseline. baseline_comparison is unavailable for this Node repository on the pinned pytest-only kernel.
title: Add one focused unit regression test
objective: Add a narrowly scoped unit test for an existing behavior without changing production authority.
whyNow: The supervised-dispatch ceremony needs a test-writing family with measurable regression evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.pattern: preserves array order while sorting nested object keys

selectionReason: A test-only change is reversible and independently verifiable.
